title: अंश ५ · अध्याय ३०

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
गरुडो वारुणं छत्रं तथैव मणिपर्वतम् ।
सभार्यं च हृषीकेशं लीलयैव वहन्ययौ ॥ ५,३०.१ ॥
items.tr:
garuḍo vāruṇaṃ chatraṃ tathaiva maṇiparvatam |
sabhāryaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ līlayaiva vahanyayau || 5,30.1 ||

items.text:
ततः शंखमुपाध्मासीत्स्वर्गद्वारगतो हरिः ।
उपतस्थुस्तथा देवाःसार्घ्यहस्ता जनर्दनम् ॥ ५,३०.२ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ śaṃkhamupādhmāsītsvargadvāragato hariḥ |
upatasthustathā devāḥsārghyahastā janardanam || 5,30.2 ||

items.text:
स देवैरर्चितः कृष्णो देवमातुर्निवेशनम् ।
सिताभ्रशिखराकारं प्रविश्य ददृशेऽदितिम् ॥ ५,३०.३ ॥
items.tr:
sa devairarcitaḥ kṛṣṇo devamāturniveśanam |
sitābhraśikharākāraṃ praviśya dadṛśe'ditim || 5,30.3 ||

items.text:
स तां प्रणम्य शक्रेण सह ते कुण्डलोत्तमे ।
ददौ नरकनाशं च शशंसास्यै जनार्दनः ॥ ५,३०.४ ॥
items.tr:
sa tāṃ praṇamya śakreṇa saha te kuṇḍalottame |
dadau narakanāśaṃ ca śaśaṃsāsyai janārdanaḥ || 5,30.4 ||

items.text:
ततः प्रीताजगन्माता धातारं जगतां हरिम् ।
तुष्टावादितिरव्यग्रा कृत्वा तत्प्रवणं मनः ॥ ५,३०.५ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ prītājaganmātā dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ harim |
tuṣṭāvāditiravyagrā kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ || 5,30.5 ||

items.text:
अदितिरुवाच
नमस्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष भक्तानामभयङ्कर ।
सनातनात्मन् सर्वात्मन् भूतात्मन् भूतभावन ॥ ५,३०.६ ॥
items.tr:
aditiruvāca
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa bhaktānāmabhayaṅkara |
sanātanātman sarvātman bhūtātman bhūtabhāvana || 5,30.6 ||

items.text:
प्रणेतर्मनसो बुद्धेरिन्द्रियाणां गुणात्मक ।
त्रिगुणातीत निर्द्वंद्व शुद्धसत्त्व हृदि स्थित ॥ ५,३०.७ ॥
items.tr:
praṇetarmanaso buddherindriyāṇāṃ guṇātmaka |
triguṇātīta nirdvaṃdva śuddhasattva hṛdi sthita || 5,30.7 ||

items.text:
सितदीर्घादिनिः शेषकल्पनापरिवर्जित ।
जन्मादिभिरसंस्पृष्ट स्वप्नादिपरिवर्जित ॥ ५,३०.८ ॥
items.tr:
sitadīrghādiniḥ śeṣakalpanāparivarjita |
janmādibhirasaṃspṛṣṭa svapnādiparivarjita || 5,30.8 ||

items.text:
संध्यारात्रिरहो भूमिर्गगनं वायुरंबु च ।
हुताशनो मनो बुद्धिर्भूतादिस्त्वं तथाच्युत ॥ ५,३०.९ ॥
items.tr:
saṃdhyārātriraho bhūmirgaganaṃ vāyuraṃbu ca |
hutāśano mano buddhirbhūtādistvaṃ tathācyuta || 5,30.9 ||

items.text:
सर्गस्थितिविनाशानां कर्ता कर्तृपतिर्भवान् ।
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाख्याभिरात्ममूर्तिभिरीश्वर ॥ ५,३०.१० ॥
items.tr:
sargasthitivināśānāṃ kartā kartṛpatirbhavān |
brahmaviṣṇuśivākhyābhirātmamūrtibhirīśvara || 5,30.10 ||

items.text:
देवा दैत्यास्तथा यक्षा राक्षसाः सिद्धपन्नगाः ।
कूष्माण्डाश्च पिशाचाश्च गन्धर्वा मनुजास्तथा ॥ ५,३०.११ ॥
items.tr:
devā daityāstathā yakṣā rākṣasāḥ siddhapannagāḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍāśca piśācāśca gandharvā manujāstathā || 5,30.11 ||

items.text:
पशवश्च मृगाश्चैव पतङ्गाश्च सरीसृपाः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलताबह्व्यःसमस्तास्तृणजातयः ॥ ५,३०.१२ ॥
items.tr:
paśavaśca mṛgāścaiva pataṅgāśca sarīsṛpāḥ |
vṛkṣagulmalatābahvyaḥsamastāstṛṇajātayaḥ || 5,30.12 ||

items.text:
स्थूला मध्यास्तथा सूक्ष्माःसूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतराश्च ये ।
देहभेदा भवान् सर्वे ये केचित्पुर्गलाश्रयाः ॥ ५,३०.१३ ॥
items.tr:
sthūlā madhyāstathā sūkṣmāḥsūkṣmātsūkṣmatarāśca ye |
dehabhedā bhavān sarve ye kecitpurgalāśrayāḥ || 5,30.13 ||

items.text:
माया तवेयमज्ञातपरमार्थातिमोहिनी ।
अनात्मन्यात्मविज्ञानं यया मूढो निरुद्ध्यते ॥ ५,३०.१४ ॥
items.tr:
māyā taveyamajñātaparamārthātimohinī |
anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ yayā mūḍho niruddhyate || 5,30.14 ||

items.text:
अस्वे स्वमिति भावोत्र यत्पुंसामुपजायते ।
अहं ममेति भावो यत्प्रायेणैवाभिजायते ।
संसारमातुर्मायायास्तवैतन्नाथ चेष्टितम् ॥ ५,३०.१५ ॥
items.tr:
asve svamiti bhāvotra yatpuṃsāmupajāyate |
ahaṃ mameti bhāvo yatprāyeṇaivābhijāyate |
saṃsāramāturmāyāyāstavaitannātha ceṣṭitam || 5,30.15 ||

items.text:
यैः स्वधर्मपरैर्नाथ नरैराराधितो भवान् ।
ते तरन्त्यखिलामेतां मायामात्मविमुक्तये ॥ ५,३०.१६ ॥
items.tr:
yaiḥ svadharmaparairnātha narairārādhito bhavān |
te tarantyakhilāmetāṃ māyāmātmavimuktaye || 5,30.16 ||

items.text:
ब्रह्माद्याःसकला देवा मनुष्याः पशवस्तथा ।
विष्णुमाया महावर्तमोहान्धतमसावृताः ॥ ५,३०.१७ ॥
items.tr:
brahmādyāḥsakalā devā manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā |
viṣṇumāyā mahāvartamohāndhatamasāvṛtāḥ || 5,30.17 ||

items.text:
आराध्य त्वामभीप्संते कामानात्मभवक्षयम् ।
यदेते पुरुषा माया सैवेयं भगवंस्तव ॥ ५,३०.१८ ॥
items.tr:
ārādhya tvāmabhīpsaṃte kāmānātmabhavakṣayam |
yadete puruṣā māyā saiveyaṃ bhagavaṃstava || 5,30.18 ||

items.text:
मया त्वं पुत्रकामिन्या वैरिपक्षजयाय च ।
आराधितो न मोक्षाय मायाविलसितं हि तत् ॥ ५,३०.१९ ॥
items.tr:
mayā tvaṃ putrakāminyā vairipakṣajayāya ca |
ārādhito na mokṣāya māyāvilasitaṃ hi tat || 5,30.19 ||

items.text:
कौपीनाच्छादनप्राया वाञ्छा कल्पद्रुमादपि ।
जायते यदपुण्यानां सोपराधः स्वदोषजः ॥ ५,३०.२० ॥
items.tr:
kaupīnācchādanaprāyā vāñchā kalpadrumādapi |
jāyate yadapuṇyānāṃ soparādhaḥ svadoṣajaḥ || 5,30.20 ||

items.text:
तत्प्रसीदाखिलजगन्मायामोहकराव्यय ।
अज्ञानं ज्ञानसद्भावभूतं भूतेश नाशय ॥ ५,३०.२१ ॥
items.tr:
tatprasīdākhilajaganmāyāmohakarāvyaya |
ajñānaṃ jñānasadbhāvabhūtaṃ bhūteśa nāśaya || 5,30.21 ||

items.text:
नमस्ते चक्रहस्ताय शार्ङ्गहस्ताय ते नमः ।
नन्दहस्ताय ते विष्णो शङ्खहस्ताय ते नमः ॥ ५,३०.२२ ॥
items.tr:
namaste cakrahastāya śārṅgahastāya te namaḥ |
nandahastāya te viṣṇo śaṅkhahastāya te namaḥ || 5,30.22 ||

items.text:
एतत्पश्यामि ते रूपं स्थूलचिह्नोपलक्षितम् ।
न जानामि परं यत्ते प्रसीद परमेश्वर ॥ ५,३०.२३ ॥
items.tr:
etatpaśyāmi te rūpaṃ sthūlacihnopalakṣitam |
na jānāmi paraṃ yatte prasīda parameśvara || 5,30.23 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
अदित्यैवं स्तुतो विष्णुः प्रहस्याह सुरारणिम् ।
माता देवि त्वमस्माकं प्रसीद वरदा भव ॥ ५,३०.२४ ॥
items.tr:
adityaivaṃ stuto viṣṇuḥ prahasyāha surāraṇim |
mātā devi tvamasmākaṃ prasīda varadā bhava || 5,30.24 ||

items.text:
अदिदिरुवाच
एवमस्तु यथेच्छा ते त्वमशेषैः सुरासुरैः ।
अजेयः पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्त्यलोके भविष्यसि ॥ ५,३०.२५ ॥
items.tr:
adidiruvāca
evamastu yathecchā te tvamaśeṣaiḥ surāsuraiḥ |
ajeyaḥ puruṣavyāghra sartyaloke bhaviṣyasi || 5,30.25 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
ततः कृष्णस्य पत्नी च शक्रेण सहितादितिम् ।
सत्यभामा प्रणम्याह प्रसीदेति पुनः पुनः ॥ ५,३०.२६ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya patnī ca śakreṇa sahitāditim |
satyabhāmā praṇamyāha prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ || 5,30.26 ||

items.text:
अदितिरुवाच
मत्प्रसादान्न ते सुभ्रु जरा वैरूप्यमेव वा ।
भविष्यत्यनवद्याङ्गि सुस्थिरं नवयौवनम् ॥ ५,३०.२७ ॥
items.tr:
aditiruvāca
matprasādānna te subhru jarā vairūpyameva vā |
bhaviṣyatyanavadyāṅgi susthiraṃ navayauvanam || 5,30.27 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
अदित्या तु कृतानुज्ञो देवराजो जनार्दनम् ।
यथावत्पूजयामास बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥ ५,३०.२८ ॥
items.tr:
adityā tu kṛtānujño devarājo janārdanam |
yathāvatpūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram || 5,30.28 ||

items.text:
शची च सत्यभामायै पारिजातस्य पुष्पकम् ।
न ददौ मानुषीं मत्वा स्वयं पुष्पैरलङ्कृता ॥ ५,३०.२९ ॥
items.tr:
śacī ca satyabhāmāyai pārijātasya puṣpakam |
na dadau mānuṣīṃ matvā svayaṃ puṣpairalaṅkṛtā || 5,30.29 ||

items.text:
ततो ददर्श कृष्णोऽपि सत्यभामासहायवान् ।
दवोद्यानानि हृद्यानि नन्दनादीनि सत्तम ॥ ५,३०.३० ॥
items.tr:
tato dadarśa kṛṣṇo'pi satyabhāmāsahāyavān |
davodyānāni hṛdyāni nandanādīni sattama || 5,30.30 ||

items.text:
ददर्श च सुगन्धाढ्यं मञ्जरीपुञ्जधारिणम् ।
नित्याह्लादकरं ताम्रबालपल्लवशोभितम् ॥ ५,३०.३१ ॥
items.tr:
dadarśa ca sugandhāḍhyaṃ mañjarīpuñjadhāriṇam |
nityāhlādakaraṃ tāmrabālapallavaśobhitam || 5,30.31 ||

items.text:
मथ्यमानेऽमृते जातं जातरूपोपमत्वचम् ।
पारिजातं जगन्नाथः केशवः केशिसूदनः ॥ ५,३०.३२ ॥
items.tr:
mathyamāne'mṛte jātaṃ jātarūpopamatvacam |
pārijātaṃ jagannāthaḥ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ || 5,30.32 ||

items.text:
तुतोष परमप्रीत्या तरुराजमनुत्तमम् ।
तं दृष्ट्वा प्राह गोविन्दं सत्यभामा द्विजोत्तम ।
कस्मान्न द्वारकामेष नीयते कृष्ण पादपः ॥ ५,३०.३३ ॥
items.tr:
tutoṣa paramaprītyā tarurājamanuttamam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha govindaṃ satyabhāmā dvijottama |
kasmānna dvārakāmeṣa nīyate kṛṣṇa pādapaḥ || 5,30.33 ||

items.text:
यदि चेत्त्वद्वचः सत्यं त्वमत्यर्थं प्रियेति मे ।
मद्गेहनिष्कुटार्थाय तदयं नीयतां तरुः ॥ ५,३०.३४ ॥
items.tr:
yadi cettvadvacaḥ satyaṃ tvamatyarthaṃ priyeti me |
madgehaniṣkuṭārthāya tadayaṃ nīyatāṃ taruḥ || 5,30.34 ||

items.text:
न मे जांबवती तादृगभीष्टा न च रुक्मिणी ।
सत्ये यथा त्वमित्युक्तं त्वया कृष्णासकृत्प्रियम् ॥ ५,३०.३५ ॥
items.tr:
na me jāṃbavatī tādṛgabhīṣṭā na ca rukmiṇī |
satye yathā tvamityuktaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇāsakṛtpriyam || 5,30.35 ||

items.text:
सत्यं तद्यदि गोविन्द नोपचारकृतं मम ।
तदस्तु पारिजातोऽयं मम गेहविभूषणम् ॥ ५,३०.३६ ॥
items.tr:
satyaṃ tadyadi govinda nopacārakṛtaṃ mama |
tadastu pārijāto'yaṃ mama gehavibhūṣaṇam || 5,30.36 ||

items.text:
बिभ्रती पारिजातस्य केशपक्षेण मञ्जरीम् ।
सपत्नीनामहं मध्ये शोभेयमिति कामये ॥ ५,३०.३७ ॥
items.tr:
bibhratī pārijātasya keśapakṣeṇa mañjarīm |
sapatnīnāmahaṃ madhye śobheyamiti kāmaye || 5,30.37 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तःस प्रहस्यैनां पारिजातं गरुत्मति ।
आरोपयामास हरिस्तमूचुर्वनरक्षिणः ॥ ५,३०.३८ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktaḥsa prahasyaināṃ pārijātaṃ garutmati |
āropayāmāsa haristamūcurvanarakṣiṇaḥ || 5,30.38 ||

items.text:
भो शची देवराजस्य महिषी तत्परीग्रहम् ।
पारिजातं न गोविन्द हर्तुमर्हसि पादपम् ॥ ५,३०.३९ ॥
items.tr:
bho śacī devarājasya mahiṣī tatparīgraham |
pārijātaṃ na govinda hartumarhasi pādapam || 5,30.39 ||

items.text:
उत्पन्नो देवराजाय दत्तःसोऽपि ददौ पुनः ।
महिष्यै सुमहाभाग देव्यै शच्यै कुतूहलात् ॥ ५,३०.४० ॥
items.tr:
utpanno devarājāya dattaḥso'pi dadau punaḥ |
mahiṣyai sumahābhāga devyai śacyai kutūhalāt || 5,30.40 ||

items.text:
शचीविभूषणार्थाय देवैरमृतमन्थने ।
उत्पादितोऽयं न क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं गमिष्यसि ॥ ५,३०.४१ ॥
items.tr:
śacīvibhūṣaṇārthāya devairamṛtamanthane |
utpādito'yaṃ na kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ gamiṣyasi || 5,30.41 ||

items.text:
देवराजो मुखप्रेक्षी यस्यास्तस्याः परिग्रहम् ।
मैढ्यात्प्रार्थयसे क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं हि को व्रजेत् ॥ ५,३०.४२ ॥
items.tr:
devarājo mukhaprekṣī yasyāstasyāḥ parigraham |
maiḍhyātprārthayase kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ hi ko vrajet || 5,30.42 ||

items.text:
अवश्यमस्य देवेन्द्रो निष्कृतिं कृष्ण यास्यति ।
वज्रोद्यतकरं शक्रमनुयास्यन्ति चामराः ॥ ५,३०.४३ ॥
items.tr:
avaśyamasya devendro niṣkṛtiṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyati |
vajrodyatakaraṃ śakramanuyāsyanti cāmarāḥ || 5,30.43 ||

items.text:
तदलं सकलैर्देवैर्विग्रहेण तवाच्युत ।
विपाककटु यत्कर्म तन्न शंसंति पण्डिताः ॥ ५,३०.४४ ॥
items.tr:
tadalaṃ sakalairdevairvigraheṇa tavācyuta |
vipākakaṭu yatkarma tanna śaṃsaṃti paṇḍitāḥ || 5,30.44 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्ते तैरुवाचैतान् सत्यभामातिकोपिनी ।
का शची पारिजातस्य को वा शक्रःसुराधिपः ॥ ५,३०.४५ ॥
items.tr:
ityukte tairuvācaitān satyabhāmātikopinī |
kā śacī pārijātasya ko vā śakraḥsurādhipaḥ || 5,30.45 ||

items.text:
सामान्यःसर्वलोकस्य यद्येषोऽमृतमन्थने ।
समुत्पन्नस्तरुः कस्मादोको गृह्णाति वासवः ॥ ५,३०.४६ ॥
items.tr:
sāmānyaḥsarvalokasya yadyeṣo'mṛtamanthane |
samutpannastaruḥ kasmādoko gṛhṇāti vāsavaḥ || 5,30.46 ||

items.text:
यथा सुरा यथैवेन्दुर्यथा श्रीर्वनरक्षिणः ।
सामान्यःसर्वलोकस्य पारिजातस्तथा द्रुमः ॥ ५,३०.४७ ॥
items.tr:
yathā surā yathaivenduryathā śrīrvanarakṣiṇaḥ |
sāmānyaḥsarvalokasya pārijātastathā drumaḥ || 5,30.47 ||

items.text:
भर्तृ बहुमहागर्वाद्रुणद्ध्येनमथो शची ।
तत्कथ्यतामलं क्षान्त्या सत्वा हारयति द्रुमम् ॥ ५,३०.४८ ॥
items.tr:
bhartṛ bahumahāgarvādruṇaddhyenamatho śacī |
tatkathyatāmalaṃ kṣāntyā satvā hārayati drumam || 5,30.48 ||

items.text:
कथ्यतां च द्रुतं गत्वा पौलोम्या वचनं मम ।
सत्यभामा वदत्येतदितिगर्वोद्धताक्षरम् ॥ ५,३०.४९ ॥
items.tr:
kathyatāṃ ca drutaṃ gatvā paulomyā vacanaṃ mama |
satyabhāmā vadatyetaditigarvoddhatākṣaram || 5,30.49 ||

items.text:
यदि त्वं दयिता भर्तुर्यदि वश्यः पतिस्तव ।
मद्भर्तुर्हरतो वृक्षं तत्कारय निवारणम् ॥ ५,३०.५० ॥
items.tr:
yadi tvaṃ dayitā bharturyadi vaśyaḥ patistava |
madbharturharato vṛkṣaṃ tatkāraya nivāraṇam || 5,30.50 ||

items.text:
जानामि ते पतिं शक्रं जानामि त्रिदशेश्वरम् ।
पारिजातं तथाप्येनं मानुषी हारयामि ते ॥ ५,३०.५१ ॥
items.tr:
jānāmi te patiṃ śakraṃ jānāmi tridaśeśvaram |
pārijātaṃ tathāpyenaṃ mānuṣī hārayāmi te || 5,30.51 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्ता रक्षिणो गत्वा शच्याः प्रोचुर्यथोदितम् ।
श्रुत्वा चोत्साहयामास शची चक्रं सुराधिपम् ॥ ५,३०.५२ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktā rakṣiṇo gatvā śacyāḥ procuryathoditam |
śrutvā cotsāhayāmāsa śacī cakraṃ surādhipam || 5,30.52 ||

items.text:
ततःसमस्तदेवानां सैन्यैः परिवृतो हरिम् ।
प्रययौ पारिजातार्थमिन्द्रोयोद्धुं द्विजोत्तम ॥ ५,३०.५३ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥsamastadevānāṃ sainyaiḥ parivṛto harim |
prayayau pārijātārthamindroyoddhuṃ dvijottama || 5,30.53 ||

items.text:
ततः परिघनिस्त्रिंशगदाशूलवरायुधाः ।
बभूवुस्त्रिदसाःसज्जाः शक्रे वज्रकरे स्थिते ॥ ५,३०.५४ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ parighanistriṃśagadāśūlavarāyudhāḥ |
babhūvustridasāḥsajjāḥ śakre vajrakare sthite || 5,30.54 ||

items.text:
ततो निरिक्ष्य गोविन्दो नागराजोपरि स्थितम् ।
शक्रं देवपरिवारं युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥ ५,३०.५५ ॥
items.tr:
tato nirikṣya govindo nāgarājopari sthitam |
śakraṃ devaparivāraṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam || 5,30.55 ||

items.text:
चकार शङ्खनिर्घोषं दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ।
मुमोच शरसंघातान् सहस्रायुतशः शितान् ॥ ५,३०.५६ ॥
items.tr:
cakāra śaṅkhanirghoṣaṃ diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan |
mumoca śarasaṃghātān sahasrāyutaśaḥ śitān || 5,30.56 ||

items.text:
ततो दिशो नभश्चैव दृष्ट्वा शरशतैश्चितम् ।
मुमुचुस्त्रिदशाःसर्वे ह्यस्त्रशस्त्राम्यनेकशः ॥ ५,३०.५७ ॥
items.tr:
tato diśo nabhaścaiva dṛṣṭvā śaraśataiścitam |
mumucustridaśāḥsarve hyastraśastrāmyanekaśaḥ || 5,30.57 ||

items.text:
एकैकमस्त्रं शस्त्रं च दैवैर्मुक्तं सहस्रशः ।
चिच्छेद लीलयैवेशो जगतां मधुसूदनः ॥ ५,३०.५८ ॥
items.tr:
ekaikamastraṃ śastraṃ ca daivairmuktaṃ sahasraśaḥ |
ciccheda līlayaiveśo jagatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 5,30.58 ||

items.text:
पाशं सलिलराजस्य समाकृष्यीरगात्पुनः ।
चकार खण्डशश्चञ्च्वा बालपन्नगदेहवत् ॥ ५,३०.५९ ॥
items.tr:
pāśaṃ salilarājasya samākṛṣyīragātpunaḥ |
cakāra khaṇḍaśaścañcvā bālapannagadehavat || 5,30.59 ||

items.text:
यमेन प्रहितं दण्डं गदाविक्षेपखण्डितम् ।
पृथिव्यां पातयामास भगवान् देवकीसुतः ॥ ५,३०.६० ॥
items.tr:
yamena prahitaṃ daṇḍaṃ gadāvikṣepakhaṇḍitam |
pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa bhagavān devakīsutaḥ || 5,30.60 ||

items.text:
शिबिकां च धनेशस्य चक्रेण तिलशो विभुः ।
चकार शौरिरर्कं च दृषृदृष्टहतौजसम् ॥ ५,३०.६१ ॥
items.tr:
śibikāṃ ca dhaneśasya cakreṇa tilaśo vibhuḥ |
cakāra śaurirarkaṃ ca dṛṣṛdṛṣṭahataujasam || 5,30.61 ||

items.text:
नीतोऽग्निः शीततां बाणैर्द्राविता वसवो दिशः ।
चक्रविच्छिन्नशुलाग्रा रुद्रा भुवि निपातिताः ॥ ५,३०.६२ ॥
items.tr:
nīto'gniḥ śītatāṃ bāṇairdrāvitā vasavo diśaḥ |
cakravicchinnaśulāgrā rudrā bhuvi nipātitāḥ || 5,30.62 ||

items.text:
साध्या विश्वेऽथ मरुतो गन्धर्वाश्चैव सा यकैः ।
शार्ङ्गिणा प्रेरितैरस्ता व्योम्नि शाल्मलितूलवत् ॥ ५,३०.६३ ॥
items.tr:
sādhyā viśve'tha maruto gandharvāścaiva sā yakaiḥ |
śārṅgiṇā preritairastā vyomni śālmalitūlavat || 5,30.63 ||

items.text:
गरुत्मानपि तुण्डेन पक्षाभ्यां च नखाङ्कुरैः ।
भक्षयंस्ताडयन् देवान् दारयंश्च चचार वै ॥ ५,३०.६४ ॥
items.tr:
garutmānapi tuṇḍena pakṣābhyāṃ ca nakhāṅkuraiḥ |
bhakṣayaṃstāḍayan devān dārayaṃśca cacāra vai || 5,30.64 ||

items.text:
ततः शतसहस्रेण देवेन्द्रमधुसूदनौ ।
परस्परं ववर्षाते धाराभिरिव तोयदौ ॥ ५,३०.६५ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ śatasahasreṇa devendramadhusūdanau |
parasparaṃ vavarṣāte dhārābhiriva toyadau || 5,30.65 ||

items.text:
ऐरावतेन गरुडो युयुधे तत्र संकुले ।
देवैः समस्तैर्युयुधे शक्रेण च जनार्दनः ॥ ५,३०.६६ ॥
items.tr:
airāvatena garuḍo yuyudhe tatra saṃkule |
devaiḥ samastairyuyudhe śakreṇa ca janārdanaḥ || 5,30.66 ||

items.text:
भिन्नेष्वशेषबाणेषु शस्त्रेष्वस्त्रेषु च त्वरन् ।
जग्राह वासवो वज्रं कृष्णश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ॥ ५,३०.६७ ॥
items.tr:
bhinneṣvaśeṣabāṇeṣu śastreṣvastreṣu ca tvaran |
jagrāha vāsavo vajraṃ kṛṣṇaścakraṃ sudarśanam || 5,30.67 ||

items.text:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं द्विजसत्तम ।
वज्रचक्रकरौ दृष्ट्वा देवाराजजनार्दनौ ॥ ५,३०.६८ ॥
items.tr:
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ dvijasattama |
vajracakrakarau dṛṣṭvā devārājajanārdanau || 5,30.68 ||

items.text:
क्षिप्तं वज्रमथेन्द्रेण जग्राह भगवान्हरिः ।
न मुमोच तदा चक्रं शक्रं तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥ ५,३०.६९ ॥
items.tr:
kṣiptaṃ vajramathendreṇa jagrāha bhagavānhariḥ |
na mumoca tadā cakraṃ śakraṃ tiṣṭheti cābravīt || 5,30.69 ||

items.text:
प्रणष्टवज्रं देवेन्द्रं गरुडक्षतवाहनम् ।
सत्यभामाब्रवीद्वीरं पलायनपरायणम् ॥ ५,३०.७० ॥
items.tr:
praṇaṣṭavajraṃ devendraṃ garuḍakṣatavāhanam |
satyabhāmābravīdvīraṃ palāyanaparāyaṇam || 5,30.70 ||

items.text:
त्रैलोक्येश न ते युक्तं शचीभर्तुः पलायनम् ।
पारिजातस्रगाभोगा त्वामुपस्थास्यते शची ॥ ५,३०.७१ ॥
items.tr:
trailokyeśa na te yuktaṃ śacībhartuḥ palāyanam |
pārijātasragābhogā tvāmupasthāsyate śacī || 5,30.71 ||

items.text:
कीदृशं देवराज्यं ते पारिजातस्रगुज्ज्वलाम् ।
अपश्यतो यथापूर्वं ग्रणयाभ्यागतां शचीम् ॥ ५,३०.७२ ॥
items.tr:
kīdṛśaṃ devarājyaṃ te pārijātasragujjvalām |
apaśyato yathāpūrvaṃ graṇayābhyāgatāṃ śacīm || 5,30.72 ||

items.text:
अलं शक्र प्रयासेन न व्रीडां गन्तुमर्हसि ।
नीयतां पारिजातोयं देवाःसंतु गतव्यथाः ॥ ५,३०.७३ ॥
items.tr:
alaṃ śakra prayāsena na vrīḍāṃ gantumarhasi |
nīyatāṃ pārijātoyaṃ devāḥsaṃtu gatavyathāḥ || 5,30.73 ||

items.text:
परिगर्वावलेपेन बहुमानपुरःसरम् ।
न ददर्श गृहं यातामुपचारेण मां शची ॥ ५,३०.७४ ॥
items.tr:
parigarvāvalepena bahumānapuraḥsaram |
na dadarśa gṛhaṃ yātāmupacāreṇa māṃ śacī || 5,30.74 ||

items.text:
स्त्रीत्वादगुरुचित्ताहं स्वभर्तृश्लाघनापरा ।
ततः कृतवती शक्र भवता सह विग्रहम् ॥ ५,३०.७५ ॥
items.tr:
strītvādagurucittāhaṃ svabhartṛślāghanāparā |
tataḥ kṛtavatī śakra bhavatā saha vigraham || 5,30.75 ||

items.text:
तदलं पारिजातेन परस्वेन हृतेन मे ।
रूपेण गर्विता सा तु भर्त्रा का स्त्री न गर्विता ॥ ५,३०.७६ ॥
items.tr:
tadalaṃ pārijātena parasvena hṛtena me |
rūpeṇa garvitā sā tu bhartrā kā strī na garvitā || 5,30.76 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तो वै निववृते देवराजस्तया द्विज ।
प्राह चैनामलं चण्डि सख्युः खेदोक्तिविस्तरैः ॥ ५,३०.७७ ॥
items.tr:
ityukto vai nivavṛte devarājastayā dvija |
prāha caināmalaṃ caṇḍi sakhyuḥ khedoktivistaraiḥ || 5,30.77 ||

items.speaker: इन्द्र उवाच
items.text:
न चापि सर्गसंहारस्थितिकर्ताखिलस्य यः ।
जितस्य तेन मे व्रीडा जायते विश्वरूपिणा ॥ ५,३०.७८ ॥
items.tr:
na cāpi sargasaṃhārasthitikartākhilasya yaḥ |
jitasya tena me vrīḍā jāyate viśvarūpiṇā || 5,30.78 ||

items.text:
यस्माज्जगत्सकलमेतदनादिमध्याद्यस्मिन्यतश्च न भविष्यति सर्वभूतात् ।
तेनोद्भवप्रलयपालनकारणेन व्रीडा कथं भवति देवि निराकृतस्य ॥ ५,३०.७९ ॥
items.tr:
yasmājjagatsakalametadanādimadhyādyasminyataśca na bhaviṣyati sarvabhūtāt |
tenodbhavapralayapālanakāraṇena vrīḍā kathaṃ bhavati devi nirākṛtasya || 5,30.79 ||

items.text:
सकलभुवनसूतिर्मूर्तिरल्पाल्पसूक्ष्माविदितसकलवेद्यैर्ज्ञायते यस्य नान्यैः ।
तमजमकृतमीशं शाश्वतं स्वेच्छयैनं जगदुपकृतिमर्त्यं को विजेतुं समर्थः ॥ ५,३०.८० ॥
items.tr:
sakalabhuvanasūtirmūrtiralpālpasūkṣmāviditasakalavedyairjñāyate yasya nānyaiḥ |
tamajamakṛtamīśaṃ śāśvataṃ svecchayainaṃ jagadupakṛtimartyaṃ ko vijetuṃ samarthaḥ || 5,30.80 ||

en_chapter: Carrying the umbrella of Varuna, the jewel mountain and Hrishikesh with his spouse on his back, Garuda went along lightly and sportively. When Hari arrived at the gate of Swarga he blew his conch on which the celestials came forward to meet him bearing respectful offerings. Having received the homage of the celestials he proceeded to the palace of the mother of gods whose turrets resembled the white clouds and found Aditi there. Thereupon having bowed unto her along with the king of celestials he conferred the pair of ear-rings upon her and related unto her the destruction of the demon Naraka. Well-pleased, Aditi, the mother of Gods with her thoughts wholly devoted unto Hari, the protector of the universe, began to chant his glories:—"Salutation unto thee, O thou having lotus eyes, who removest all fear of the devotees, who art eternal, the soul of all creatures, the creator of all and identical with all. Thou art at one with the three qualities and the creator of mind, intellect and senses. Thou art beyond the three qualities, exempt from contraries, pure, residing in the hearts of all; void of colour, extension and every transient modification and uninfluenced by the changes of birth and death and sleep and waking. Thou art evening, night and day, earth, sky, air, water and fire, mind, intellect and individuality. Thou art the agent of creation, preservation and destruction and the lord over the agent—thou appearest in various forms which are Brahmā, Vishnu and Siva—and thou art the master of all these thy forms. Thou art Gods, Yakshas, Daityas, Rākshasas, Sidhas, Pannagas, Kushmandas, Pisāchas, Gandharvas, men, animals, deer, elephants, reptiles, trees, shrubs, creepers, climbers, and grasses—all things, large, middling, and small, immense or minute; thou art all bodies whatsoever composed of aggregated atoms. Those who are ignorant of thy true nature cannot understand thy illusion—the fools (only) follow the illusion and think 'this is mine'. O Lord, thy illusion is the mother of the world—and the notions 'I am, this is mine' are but delusions. O Lord, those men, who attentive to their duties, worship thee, obtain salvation after traversing these illusions. Brahmā and all the celestials, men and animals are alike enshrouded by the thick darkness of delusion in the abyss of the illusions of Vishnu. This is also thy delusion, O lord, that men having worshipped thee seek the gratification of desires and their own preservation. That people having worshipped thee desire for the total annihilation of themselves is but the outcome of thy delusion. That I have worshipped thee for son and the destruction of the enemies and not for salvation is also the result of thy fascination. It is the fruit of the iniquitous acts of the impious (to pray for vain things to one who is able to give better things) like asking for a rag to cover nakedness from the tree that confers whatever is solicited from it. Be propitious with me, O thou imperishable, who hast deceived the whole universe with thy delusion. O lord of creatures, do thou remove this ignorance of mine—the notion that I am wise; salutation unto thee, the holder of discus; salutation unto thee the wielder of bow; salutation unto thee, the holder of a club; salutation unto thee, the holder of a conch. O god, I do perceive thy perceptible form—but cannot perceive thy real form; do thou therefore be propitious with me".
Parāçara said:—The mother of gods, having thus chanted the glories of Vishnu, he smiling said:—"Thou art our mother, O goddess, be thou propitious and confer upon me a boon".

Aditi said:—"So be it, ever as thou wilt; O foremost of men, as long as shalt thou dwell in the land of mortals thou shalt be invincible by celestials and demons". Thereupon Satyabhāmā, along with Sachi, bowed unto Aditi again and again and said, "Be thou pleased". Whereto Aditi replied saying:—"Fair-browed dame, by my favour thou shalt never experience decrepitude or loss of beauty; thou shalt be of a blameless person and asylum of all graces".

Parāçara said:—Being commanded by Aditi, the lord of the celestials duly honored Janārddana. Thereupon Krishna, accompanied by Satyabhāmā beheld Nandana and other pleasant gardens of the celestials. There Kesava, the lord of the universe and the slayer of Kesi, saw Pārijāta, the favourite of Sachi, having golden bark, young sprouting leaves of a copper colour and bearing numerous fragrant clusters of flowers, and which was produced when the ocean was churned for ambrosia. Beholding that tree, O foremost of twice-born ones, Satyabhāmā said to Govinda. "Why should not this celestial tree be taken to Dwārakā. If what you always say is true that I am really dear to you then take this tree from here for the gardens of my dwelling. O Krishna, you always say 'O Satya, neither Rukmini nor Jāmbavati is beloved unto me like thee,' if this is true and not mere flattery then let this Pārijāta be the ornament of my dwelling. Wearing the flowers of this tree in the braids of my hair I wish to appear graceful amidst my fellow queens".
Parāçara said:—Thus requested by Satyabhāmā Hari, smiled and taking the Pārijāta plant placed it upon Garuda.

The guards said: "O Govinda, this tree belongs to Sachi, the queen of the king of celestials; it is not becoming for thee to remove it. When the ocean was churned by the celestials this tree was produced for the purpose of providing Sachi with flowery ornaments; thou shalt not go with it uncatched. This is the property of one whose countenance the king of the celestials delights to look; it is out of ignorance that thou dost attempt to take it—taking this no one shall be suffered to depart in peace. Forsooth shall the celestial chief punish this audacity; and when he shall take up his thunderbolt all the deities shall follow him. O thou imperishable, it is not proper for thee, to enter into conflict with all the divinities. The wise never undertake a work that terminates fatally". The guards having said this Satyabhāmā was greatly worked up with ire and said: "How does this Pārijāta belong to Sachi? Who is Sakra, the lord of the celestials? If this had been produced when the ocean was churned by the celestials then all have equal right over it—why shall Vāsava alone possess it? O ye warders of the garden, ambrosia, the moon and Lakshmi are the common properties of all; so is this Pārijāta tree. If Sachi has taken possession of it forcibly by the valour of her husband, do ye go and communicate unto her that Satyabhāmā is taking it away and let not Sachi forgive her. Do ye soon go to her and according to my instructions tell her that Satyabhāmā has given vent to these proud words. 'If thou art dear unto thy husband, if he is under thine control then let him take back the Pārijāta tree which my husband is taking away. I know thy husband Sakra is the master of the three worlds. Still being a mortal I take away this Panjata tree.'"

Parāçara said:—Being thus accosted, the warders went to Sachi and communicated unto her everything duly. And Sachi excited the lord of the three worlds. Thereupon accompanied by the army of the celestials, Indra, issued out to fight with Hari, in defence of the Pārijāta tree. The celestials were armed with clubs, swords, maces and darts and Indra wielded the thunderbolt. As soon as Govinda beheld the king of the celestials proceeding against him mounted on his elephant attended by the immortals he blew his shell so that all regions were filled with the sound thereof and he smilingly showered myriads of shafts upon his assailants. When the celestials saw that all the directions and atmosphere were overspread with arrows they also in return hurled numberless missiles. But all these, the slayer of Madhu, and the lord of the three worlds, sundered easily into a thousand pieces with his shafts. Garuda, the devourer of serpents, laid hold of the noose of the king of seas and tore it to pieces with his beak as if it had been a little snake. Devaki's son hurled his mace at the club of Yama and cast it broken upon the ground; he sundered in pieces the litter of the lord of riches with his discus; his eye-looks overclouded the radiance of the sun; he cut Agni into a hundred parts with his shafts and scattered the Vasus through the realms of the space; he sundered with his discus the points of the tridents of the Rudras and cast themselves upon the earth; and with the arrows shot from his bow he scattered the Sadhyas, Viswas, Maruts and Gandharvas through the sky, like fleeces of cotton from the pods of the Simal tree. Garuda also diligently plied his beak and wings and bit and bruised and scratched the celestials who opposed his lord. Like unto two heavy clouds showering raindrops the king of the celestials and the slayer of Madhu overpowered each other with numberless arrows. Garuda fought with Airavata in that conflict and Janārddana engaged with his discus with all the celestials. When all other weapons had been sundered into pieces Indra stood armed with his thunderbolt and Krishna with the discus Sudarshana. Beholding them thus ready for fight all the inhabitants of the three worlds, cried aloud "Alas! Alas!" In vain did Indra hurl his bolt for Hari caught and arrested it. He however, did not hurl his discus, but only called out to Indra to stay. Beholding Indra disarmed and his elephant disabled by Garuda and the deity about to fly away Satyabhāmā said to him:—"O king of three worlds, it becomes not the husband of Sachi to run away. She will approach you adorned with Pārijāta garlands. What shalt thou do with the kingdom of heaven when no longer thou dost behold Sachi approach thee, like before, embellished with Pārijāta garlands? Fly not O Sakra; you must suffer shame, take the Pārijatā; let the celestials be no longer annoyed. Worked up with the pride of her husband Sachi has not welcomed me to her dwelling with her respectful presents. O king of the celestials, I am a woman and therefore of light purpose and am anxious of my husband's fame; for this I have instituted this fight with thee. I do not require the Pārijatā any more. Why shall we steal another's property? What female is not inflated with the pride of her husband? But she is proud of her beauty".

Parāçara said:—Thus addressed by her the king of the celestials turned back and said:—"O wrathful dame, thou shouldst not afflict thy friend with further reproaches. I am not ashamed of being defeated by him who is the author of the creation, preservation and destruction of the world, who is the substance of all things, and in whom the universe exists, without beginning or middle, and from whom and by whom at one with all things, it proceeds and will cease to be. O goddess, what disgrace it is to any one, to be vanquished by him who is the agent of creation, preservation and destruction? His form, though infinitely subtle, is the parent of all worlds and is known to those only by whom all that may be known is known; who is capable of defeating the unborn, unconstituted, eternal lord, who has, of his own accord, descended for the behoof of the world?"
